# Association of Genomic and IMC (here myeloid) data 

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggpubr)
```

# Read in data 

```{r}
# Read in genomics data 
## 1A: Mutations 
mut_anno <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_full_withmeta.csv")
mut_per_PID <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/mutation_per_PID_binary.csv")
  
## 1B: Genomic subtypes 
genomic_sub <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/genomic_subtype_anno_final.csv")
```

# Differential abundance testing based 

## 1. Immune subtypes

```{r}
# Read and subset sce object 
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

# Subset for PID for which we have genomics data
sce <- sce[,sce$PID %in% genomic_sub$PID]
```


```{r}
# Add relevant metadata to sce 
mut_per_PID <- as.data.frame(mut_per_PID)

# Mutation encoding 
## Only clonal 
mut_per_PID_clonal <- mut_per_PID
mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- ifelse(mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] >= 1, 1,0)
colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- paste0(colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)], "_clonal")
GOI_clonal <- colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal %>% select(-PID))

for (entry in GOI_clonal) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- mut_per_PID_clonal[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],mut_per_PID_clonal[,"PID"])]
}

## All 
mut_per_PID_all <- mut_per_PID
mut_per_PID_all[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)] <- ifelse(mut_per_PID_all[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)] >= 0.5, 1,0)
colnames(mut_per_PID_all)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)] <- paste0(colnames(mut_per_PID_all)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_all)], "_all")
GOI_all <- colnames(mut_per_PID_all %>% select(-PID))

for (entry in GOI_all) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- mut_per_PID_all[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],mut_per_PID_all[,"PID"])]
}
```


```{r}
# Add relevant metadata to sce 
## Genomic subtypes and evolution type 
genom_add <- colnames(genomic_sub)[colnames(genomic_sub) %in% c("genomic_subtype", "evolution_type", "evolution_type_comb")]

genomic_sub <- as.data.frame(genomic_sub)

for (entry in genom_add) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- genomic_sub[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],genomic_sub[,"PID"])]
}
```

```{r}
# Create binary categories 
## Genomic subtypes
sce$VHL_wildtype <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "VHL_wildtype", "1", "0")
sce$PBRM1_driven <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "PBRM1_driven", "1", "0")
sce$BAP1_driven <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "BAP1_driven", "1", "0")
sce$VHL_monodriver <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "VHL_monodriver", "1", "0")
sce$multiple_drivers <- ifelse(sce$genomic_subtype == "multiple_drivers", "1", "0")

## Evolutionary subtypes
sce$punctuated_like <- ifelse(sce$evolution_type == "punctuated_like", "1", "0")
sce$branched_like <- ifelse(sce$evolution_type == "branched_like", "1", "0")
sce$linear_like <- ifelse(sce$evolution_type == "linear_like", "1", "0")
```


### Mutation types 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

GOI_all <- GOI_all[!GOI_all %in% c("SF3B1_all","ELOC_all","STAG2_all","ARHGAP35_all")]
  
DA <- lapply(GOI_all, function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster_combined), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}

                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))
```

```{r}
# Select myeloid cells only 
DA_out <- DA_out[str_detect(DA_out$cluster, "MY"),]
DA_out <- DA_out[complete.cases(DA_out),]

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

GOI_clonal <- GOI_clonal[!GOI_clonal %in% c("SF3B1_clonal","ELOC_clonal","STAG2_clonal","ARHGAP35_clonal")]
  
DA <- lapply(GOI_clonal, function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_immune$celltype_combined, sce_immune$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_immune)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_immune$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

##### Myeloid cell proportions

```{r}
# Subset to just myeloid cells
sce_MY <- sce_immune[,str_detect(sce_immune$celltype_combined, "MY")]
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("punctuated_like", "branched_like", "linear_like"), function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_MY$celltype_combined, sce_MY$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_MY)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_MY$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.1, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.1 with trends
DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
}
```

### Mutation types 

```{r}
GOI_all <- GOI_all[!GOI_all %in% c("SF3B1_all","ELOC_all","STAG2_all","ARHGAP35_all")]
GOI_clonal <- GOI_clonal[!GOI_clonal %in% c("SF3B1_clonal","ELOC_clonal","STAG2_clonal","ARHGAP35_clonal")]
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, M2_dom, M1_dom, AgM_dom, MDSC_dom) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI all 
cur_mut_all <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, GOI_all) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("M2_dom", "M1_dom","AgM_dom","MDSC_dom"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_all, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}

                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.1, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio

  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
```

### Oncoprints per group  

```{r}
variant_combined_full <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/variant_combined_full_withmeta.csv")
```

```{r}
# ccRCC mutational driver genes 
GOI_IntOGen <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/genome/data_analysis/data/IntOGen_DriverGenes_CCRCC.tsv")
GOI <- GOI_IntOGen$Symbol #n = 44
GOI <- c(GOI, "ELOC") # Add ELOC (TCEB1)
```

```{r}
#Load processed data file and select columns of interest
snv <- variant_combined_full

# Select PID 
PID_select <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(!is.na(PID_metagroups_names)) %>% pull(PID) %>% unique()
snv <- snv %>% filter(PID %in% PID_select)

snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined

snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)

mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
## A: All genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
## B: Genes of Interest e.g. IntOGen driver genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
Genes_list <- Genes_list[!Genes_list %in% c("SF3B1","ELOC","STAG2","ARHGAP35")]


#Placeholders 
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]

for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  
  #select all SNVs/Indels of the mut_level and give a value of 1
  x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |       #allow for multi-Genes mutations
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    
    #transpose and replace NA by 0
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}

#Unify matrices
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)

# Create a new list entry called "Multiple" for multiple gene mutations within a PID
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))

# keep the order of annotation and mutation list
#ord= anno$PID_short
  
# show every gene and patient
# blank for patients  and.or genes missing 
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  #mut_list_full[[i]]=mut_list_full[[i]][,ord]
}

# Optional: Create a new list entry called "Clonality" for gene mutation clonality annotation per PID
subclonal_anno <- variant_combined_full %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))

subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]

mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno
```


```{r print onc, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE, fig.width=10,fig.height=7}
## Step 1: Define alteration function

#Colors
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(7,"Paired"))(length(unique(snv$mut_level))+1)

# alter_fun function 
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[7], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "protein_altering_variant", "multiple")
test_alter_fun(fun_alter)

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))

# Add myeloid patient groups

c_anno$PID_metagroups_scaled_names <- sce$PID_metagroups_scaled_names[match(c_anno$PID, sce$PID)]

## 2A: Patient metadata
groups_col <- setNames(c("orange3","seagreen","pink2","firebrick"),unique(c_anno$PID_metagroups_names))
subtype_col <- setNames(c("#046C9A", "#000000", "#D69C4E", "#ECCBAE", "#ABDDDE"),c("BAP1_driven", "multiple_drivers", "PBRM1_driven","VHL_monodriver", "VHL_wildtype"))

ca_PID <- columnAnnotation(myeloid_subtype = c_anno$PID_metagroups_names,
                           myeloid_subtype_2 = c_anno$PID_metagroups_scaled_names,
                           genomic_subtype = c_anno$genomic_subtype, 
                           col = list(myeloid_subtype = groups_col, 
                                      myeloid_subtype_2 = groups_col, 
                                      genomic_subtype = subtype_col)
                           )

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

  
## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                  column_split = c_anno$PID_metagroups_names, 
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v% ca_PID #%v% ca_prog
  

draw(ht_all)
```

## 2. Proportion split based 

```{r}
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(myeloid_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_myeloid_metacluster <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_myeloid_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "myeloid_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 
# Mean split
Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"1","0")) %>% pull(mean)}

# tertile split
Cox_df_tert <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% 
    mutate(tert = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] < quantile(Cox_df[,i], probs = seq(0,1,0.33))[2],"0",
                         ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > quantile(Cox_df[,i], probs = seq(0,1,0.33))[3], "1", NA))) %>% pull(tert)
  }

Cox_df_mean <- Cox_df_tert

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)
Cox_df_mean <- Cox_df_mean %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
```


### Mutation types 

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- Cox_df_mean

# Binary mutation matrix
## Here GOI all 
cur_mut_all <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, GOI_all) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Ag_M", "C_M", "M1_like", "M2_like", "Neutro_MDSC"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_all, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

### Genomic subtypes 

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- Cox_df_mean

# Binary subtypes
cur_genome <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, VHL_wildtype, PBRM1_driven, VHL_monodriver, BAP1_driven, multiple_drivers) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Ag_M", "C_M", "M1_like", "M2_like", "Neutro_MDSC"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_genome, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

## Genomic subtypes 

### All cells included for proportions

```{r}
PID_celltype_combined <- colData(sce_immune) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(celltype_combined,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_celltype_combined <- PID_celltype_combined %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))
PID_metagroups <- PID_celltype_combined %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "celltype_combined",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
```


```{r}
## Add subtypes 
PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven <- sce_immune$BAP1_driven[match(rownames(PID_metagroups), sce_immune$PID)]
PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven <- as.factor(PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven)
PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven <- relevel(x=PID_metagroups$BAP1_driven, ref = "0")

PID_metagroups$PBRM1_driven <- sce_immune$PBRM1_driven[match(rownames(PID_metagroups), sce_immune$PID)]
```

# Other ideas 

Other ideas: Logit-transform for linear regression (like Raza in Nature Cancer )

```{r}
#logit transform 
PID_metagroups <- as.data.frame.matrix(apply(PID_metagroups, 2, function(x){log(x / (1 - x))}))

PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M[PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M == -Inf] <- min(PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M[PID_metagroups$MY_Ag_M != -Inf])

PID_metagroups <- as.data.frame.matrix(apply(PID_metagroups, 2, function(x){
  x[x == -Inf] <- min(x[x != -Inf])
  return(x)
  }))
```
